en.text: In the sixth year, in the sixth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I sat in my house, and the elders of Judah sat before me, the Lord GOD’s hand fell on me there.

zhSimplified.text: 第六年六月初五日，我坐在家中；犹大的众长老坐在我面前。在那里主耶和华的灵降在我身上。

zhTraditional.text: 第六年六月初五日，我坐在家中；猶大的眾長老坐在我面前。在那裏主耶和華的靈降在我身上。

en.text: Then I saw, and behold, a likeness as the appearance of fire—from the appearance of his waist and downward, fire, and from his waist and upward, as the appearance of brightness, as it were glowing metal.

zhSimplified.text: 我观看，见有形象仿佛火的形状，从他腰以下的形状有火，从他腰以上有光辉的形状，仿佛光耀的精金。

zhTraditional.text: 我觀看，見有形像彷彿火的形狀，從他腰以下的形狀有火，從他腰以上有光輝的形狀，彷彿光耀的精金。

en.text: He stretched out the form of a hand, and took me by a lock of my head; and the Spirit lifted me up between earth and the sky, and brought me in the visions of God to Jerusalem, to the door of the gate of the inner court that looks toward the north, where there was the seat of the image of jealousy, which provokes to jealousy.

zhSimplified.text: 他伸出仿佛一只手的样式，抓住我的一绺头发，灵就将我举到天地中间，在 神的异象中，带我到耶路撒冷朝北的内院门口，在那里有触动主怒偶像的坐位，就是惹动忌邪的。

zhTraditional.text: 他伸出彷彿一隻手的樣式，抓住我的一綹頭髮，靈就將我舉到天地中間，在上帝的異象中，帶我到耶路撒冷朝北的內院門口，在那裏有觸動主怒偶像的坐位，就是惹動忌邪的。

en.text: Behold, the glory of the God of Israel was there, according to the appearance that I saw in the plain.

zhSimplified.text: 谁知，在那里有以色列 神的荣耀，形状与我在平原所见的一样。

zhTraditional.text: 誰知，在那裏有以色列上帝的榮耀，形狀與我在平原所見的一樣。

en.text: Then he said to me, “Son of man, lift up your eyes now the way toward the north.” So I lifted up my eyes the way toward the north, and saw, northward of the gate of the altar this image of jealousy in the entry.

zhSimplified.text: 神对我说：「人子啊，你举目向北观看。」我就举目向北观看，见祭坛门的北边，在门口有这惹忌邪的偶像；

zhTraditional.text: 上帝對我說：「人子啊，你舉目向北觀看。」我就舉目向北觀看，見祭壇門的北邊，在門口有這惹忌邪的偶像；

en.text: He said to me, “Son of man, do you see what they do? Even the great abominations that the house of Israel commit here, that I should go far off from my sanctuary? But you will again see yet other great abominations.”

zhSimplified.text: 又对我说：「人子啊，以色列家所行的，就是在此行这大可憎的事，使我远离我的圣所，你看见了吗？你还要看见另有大可憎的事。」

zhTraditional.text: 又對我說：「人子啊，以色列家所行的，就是在此行這大可憎的事，使我遠離我的聖所，你看見了嗎？你還要看見另有大可憎的事。」

en.text: He brought me to the door of the court; and when I looked, behold, a hole in the wall.

zhSimplified.text: 他领我到院门口。我观看，见墙上有个窟窿。

zhTraditional.text: 他領我到院門口。我觀看，見牆上有個窟窿。

en.text: Then he said to me, “Son of man, dig now in the wall.” When I had dug in the wall, I saw a door.

zhSimplified.text: 他对我说：「人子啊，你要挖墙。」我一挖墙，见有一门。

zhTraditional.text: 他對我說：「人子啊，你要挖牆。」我一挖牆，見有一門。

en.text: He said to me, “Go in, and see the wicked abominations that they do here.”

zhSimplified.text: 他说：「你进去，看他们在这里所行可憎的恶事。」

zhTraditional.text: 他說：「你進去，看他們在這裏所行可憎的惡事。」

en.text: So I went in and looked, and saw every form of creeping things, abominable animals, and all the idols of the house of Israel, portrayed around on the wall.

zhSimplified.text: 我进去一看，谁知，在四面墙上画着各样爬物和可憎的走兽，并以色列家一切的偶像。

zhTraditional.text: 我進去一看，誰知，在四面牆上畫着各樣爬物和可憎的走獸，並以色列家一切的偶像。

en.text: Seventy men of the elders of the house of Israel stood before them. In the middle of them Jaazaniah the son of Shaphan stood, every man with his censer in his hand; and the smell of the cloud of incense went up.

zhSimplified.text: 在这些像前有以色列家的七十个长老站立，沙番的儿子雅撒尼亚也站在其中。各人手拿香炉，烟云的香气上腾。

zhTraditional.text: 在這些像前有以色列家的七十個長老站立，沙番的兒子雅撒尼亞也站在其中。各人手拿香爐，煙雲的香氣上騰。

en.text: Then he said to me, “Son of man, have you seen what the elders of the house of Israel do in the dark, every man in his rooms of imagery? For they say, ‘The LORD doesn’t see us. The LORD has forsaken the land.’”

zhSimplified.text: 他对我说：「人子啊，以色列家的长老暗中在各人画像屋里所行的，你看见了吗？他们常说：『耶和华看不见我们；耶和华已经离弃这地。』」

zhTraditional.text: 他對我說：「人子啊，以色列家的長老暗中在各人畫像屋裏所行的，你看見了嗎？他們常說：『耶和華看不見我們；耶和華已經離棄這地。』」

en.text: He said also to me, “You will again see more of the great abominations which they do.”

zhSimplified.text: 他又说：「你还要看见他们另外行大可憎的事。」

zhTraditional.text: 他又說：「你還要看見他們另外行大可憎的事。」

en.text: Then he brought me to the door of the gate of the LORD’s house which was toward the north; and I saw the women sit there weeping for Tammuz.

zhSimplified.text: 他领我到耶和华殿外院朝北的门口。谁知，在那里有妇女坐着，为搭模斯哭泣。

zhTraditional.text: 他領我到耶和華殿外院朝北的門口。誰知，在那裏有婦女坐着，為搭模斯哭泣。

en.text: Then he said to me, “Have you seen this, son of man? You will again see yet greater abominations than these.”

zhSimplified.text: 他对我说：「人子啊，你看见了吗？你还要看见比这更可憎的事。」

zhTraditional.text: 他對我說：「人子啊，你看見了嗎？你還要看見比這更可憎的事。」

en.text: He brought me into the inner court of the LORD’s house; and I saw at the door of the LORD’s temple, between the porch and the altar, there were about twenty-five men with their backs toward the LORD’s temple and their faces toward the east. They were worshiping the sun toward the east.

zhSimplified.text: 他又领我到耶和华殿的内院。谁知，在耶和华的殿门口、廊子和祭坛中间，约有二十五个人背向耶和华的殿，面向东方拜日头。

zhTraditional.text: 他又領我到耶和華殿的內院。誰知，在耶和華的殿門口、廊子和祭壇中間，約有二十五個人背向耶和華的殿，面向東方拜日頭。

en.text: Then he said to me, “Have you seen this, son of man? Is it a light thing to the house of Judah that they commit the abominations which they commit here? For they have filled the land with violence, and have turned again to provoke me to anger. Behold, they put the branch to their nose.

zhSimplified.text: 他对我说：「人子啊，你看见了吗？犹大家在此行这可憎的事还算为小吗？他们在这地遍行强暴，再三惹我发怒，他们手拿枝条举向鼻前。

zhTraditional.text: 他對我說：「人子啊，你看見了嗎？猶大家在此行這可憎的事還算為小嗎？他們在這地遍行強暴，再三惹我發怒，他們手拿枝條舉向鼻前。

en.text: Therefore I will also deal in wrath. My eye won’t spare, neither will I have pity. Though they cry in my ears with a loud voice, yet I will not hear them.”

zhSimplified.text: 因此，我也要以忿怒行事，我眼必不顾惜，也不可怜他们；他们虽向我耳中大声呼求，我还是不听。」

zhTraditional.text: 因此，我也要以忿怒行事，我眼必不顧惜，也不可憐他們；他們雖向我耳中大聲呼求，我還是不聽。」
